entries.099cf6bf9a0b0fbf: Gecoss Kouji Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, provides technical support for the safe execution of temporary construction work and related services. Amounts by category are not separately disclosed.
entries.21471a2d8fb7af6a: This business is conducted by Rental System Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, which rents construction machinery. entries.454c41e04b24cfcb: This business centers on the rental and sale of temporary steel materials for construction works, and also includes the design and execution of related temporary construction work, and the manufacture and sale of specially processed products, among others. The company and eight consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate carry out this business, and it also has bases in Singapore and Vietnam. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥102,116 million.
